title: 7S.2c raw/typed entity collision-set elimination fast slice
scope: Continue the 7S.2c writer-owned scratch census in dx_iface::fileExport
Remove the full typed-entity handle set that was built only to reject collisions with raw entity handles
Avoid typed-entity scanning and indexing entirely when the input contains no raw entity events

method.kind: Local source audit and existing strict raw-plus-typed entity collision regression
method.limitations: Raw handle uniqueness and cross-family collision refusal remain structurally checked, but no allocator/RSS benchmark or external consumer qualification was performed. The workspace Git metadata is read-only, so this implementation and its plan entry remain uncommitted.

details: Validate and reserve raw entity handles in one pass while retaining only the raw-handle uniqueness set.
When raw entities exist, scan typed entity lists and query raw-handle membership directly; remove the full typedEntityHandles set. When the raw set is empty, skip the typed collision scan.
A collision still fails export before dxfRW::write and destination publication; the writer is discarded on failure.
